Krishna Janmashtami Celebrated Across India with Devotion and Festivities

Across India, Krishna Janmashtami was celebrated with widespread enthusiasm and devotion. Temples were elaborately decorated, and devotees participated in special prayers and rituals to commemorate the birth of Lord Krishna. Major celebrations were reported in Mathura and Vrindavan, with devotees flocking to the birthplace of Krishna. Similar festivities and large gatherings of devotees were observed in other significant religious sites and cities nationwide, including Jaipur, Dwarka, and various locations in Uttar Pradesh. Political leaders, including Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, extended greetings, highlighting the inspirational aspects of Krishna's life. The celebrations also saw participation from athletes and included cultural elements like folk performances and 'dahi handi' events in some regions.
